# Recipe

```{r}
#| label: recipes

build_recipes <- function(data, roles_df = NULL, smote = FALSE) {
  #' Build Recipes for Workflow
  #'
  #' All Workflows need analogous recipes. Set with this function
  #'
  #' @param data : data resamples were drawn from
  #' @param roles_df : df containing roles in original df.
  #' defaults to NULL, uses freshly loaded one in that case
  #' @param smote : logical, whether to apply smote for class balance
  #'
  #' @return recipe

  if (is.null(data)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # load df if not provided
  if (is.null(roles_df)) {
    roles_df <- load_roles_df()
  }

  # reduce data to formula cols
  data <- data %>%
    select_formula_cols(roles_df = roles_df)

  # get names of cols
  predictor_cols <- roles_df %>%
    filter(role == "predictor") %>%
    pull(variable)

  outcome_col <- roles_df %>%
    filter(role == "outcome") %>%
    pull(variable)

  weight_col <- roles_df %>%
    filter(role == "case_weights") %>%
    pull(variable)

  # build base
  r_base <- recipe(
    x = data,
    formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ ."))
  )

  # add smote
  if (smote) {
    r_base <- r_base %>%
      step_smote(all_outcomes(), skip = TRUE)
  }

  # gb and glmnet require dummies
  r_dummy <- r_base %>%
    step_dummy(all_factor_predictors())

  # zero variance removal for all models
  r_base <- r_base %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors())

  r_dummy <- r_dummy %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors())

  r_complete <- list(
    "elnet" = r_dummy,
    "rf" = r_base,
    "gb" = r_dummy
  )

  return(r_complete)
}

recipes_all_base <- map(train_all, build_recipes)
recipes_all_smote <- map(train_all, ~ build_recipes(., smote = TRUE))
```


# Prepare Crossvalidation

If i dont need to use upsampling, i can rely on vfold validation.

If i want to use upsampling, need to make my own cv draw function, as i need to both a) respect sampling weights (which i can do here by doing weighted sampling) and b) smote later, which assumes equal sampling weights.

```{r}
#| label: weighted mc cv function

# seed is set internally in the weighted_mc_cv function.
mc_all <- map(train_all, ~ weighted_mc_cv(.,
  weight_col = "weight",
  times = 5,
  train_prop = 0.8,
  compress_weight = FALSE
))
```

```{r}
#| label: vfold function

# seed is set internally in the split_vfold wrapper function.
vfold_all <- map(train_all, ~ split_vfold(., strata = outcome_var))
```

# Select variation

```{r}
#| label: select variation of cv and recipe

recipes_all <- recipes_all_base
cv_all <- vfold_all
```

# Define Model workflow

models to implement:
1. elastic net logistic regression
  -> hyperparams are penalty and mixture
2. random forest
  -> important hyperparams are mtry and min_n
3. gradient boosting
  -> 8 params, most important are probs tree_depth, trees

```{r}
#| label: model specifications

# elnet
spec_elnet <- logistic_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

# rf
spec_rf <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 500) %>%
  set_engine("ranger",
    num.threads = 1,
    probability = TRUE,
    importance = "permutation"
  ) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

# gb
spec_gb <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(),
  tree_depth = tune(),
  learn_rate = tune(),
  min_n = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(),
  sample_size = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost", nthread = 1) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

spec_all <- list(
  "elnet" = spec_elnet,
  "rf" = spec_rf,
  "gb" = spec_gb
)
```

```{r}
#| label: set parameter ranges

params_all <- imap(recipes_all, \(recipes_imp, imp) {
  imp <- list(
    elnet = spec_elnet %>%
      extract_parameter_set_dials() %>%
      update(
        penalty = penalty(range = c(-10, 0)), # default range
        mixture = mixture(range = c(0, 1)) # default is 0.05 - 1, but i want to include pure ridge model too.
      ),
    rf = spec_rf %>%
      extract_parameter_set_dials() %>%
      update( # leaving mtry as default, as thats already dynamic to var count
        min_n = min_n(range = c(2, 50)) # slightly increased upper limit, to see if smooth trees help maybe
      ) %>%
      finalize(recipes_imp$rf$template), # sets mtry max to nrow of predictor template df
    gb = spec_gb %>%
      extract_parameter_set_dials() %>%
      update(
        trees = trees(range = c(100, 2000)), # default
        tree_depth = tree_depth(range = c(1, 10)), # reduced max from 15 to 10 to avoid overfitting
        learn_rate = learn_rate(range = c(-3, -0.5)), # default
        min_n = min_n(range = c(2, 50)), # increased max, see rf, using same range for comparison
        loss_reduction = loss_reduction(range = c(-5, 1)), # significantly increased lower limit to avoid massive trees
        sample_size = sample_prop(range = c(0.5, 1)) # default
      )
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: initial grid sizes

init_grid_all <- imap(params_all, \(params_imp, imp) {
  imp <- imap(params_imp, \(params_model, model) {
    model <- length(params_model$object) + 2
  })
})
```

```{r}
#| label: set maximization metrics

tune_metrics <- metric_set(
  average_precision,
  pr_auc,
  roc_auc,
  brier_class,
  mn_log_loss
)
```

```{r}
#| label: build workflow sets

tune_wf_set <- function(models,
                        recipes,
                        resamples,
                        params,
                        metrics,
                        initial,
                        iter = 40,
                        save_workflow = FALSE,
                        save_pred = FALSE,
                        time_limit = 180,
                        seed = 94) {
  #' Build Workflow Set
  #'
  #' function description
  #'
  #' @param models : models list, should be same for comparison
  #' @param recipes : named recipes list
  #' @param resamples : corresponding resample
  #' @param params : named list of parameter ranges with the elements coming from extract_parameter_set_dials %>% update
  #' @param metrics : metrics used at end. first metric is the one optimized for.
  #' @param initial : named list of initial grid sizes
  #' @param iter : max nr of iterations of tune_bayes (initial grid not included). defaults to 40.
  #' @param save_pred : logical whether to save predictions from all tuning attempts. defaults to FALSE.
  #' @param seed : rng seed, defaults to 94
  #'
  #' @return workflow_set object


  wf_set <- workflow_set(
    preproc = recipes,
    models = models,
    cross = FALSE,
    case_weights = weight
  )


  # add parameters & initial grid size per model
  for (model_name in names(params)) {
    wf_id <- paste0(model_name, "_", model_name)

    wf_set <- wf_set %>%
      option_add(
        param_info = params[[model_name]],
        initial = initial[[model_name]],
        id = wf_id
      )
  }

  set.seed(seed)
  tuned <- wf_set %>%
    workflow_map(
      fn = "tune_bayes",
      resamples = resamples,
      metrics = metrics,
      iter = iter,
      control = control_bayes(
        verbose_iter = TRUE,
        save_workflow = save_workflow,
        save_pred = save_pred,
        parallel_over = "resamples",
        time_limit = time_limit
      ),
      # parallelization hopefully helps
      verbose = TRUE
    )

  return(tuned)
}
```

# tester

```{r}
#| label: test

model_id <- "elnet" # elnet, rf, gb
data_id <- "avg" # avg, model, bag

{
  # enable parallelization
  workers <- min(
    parallelly::availableCores() - 1,
    max(
      nrow(cv_all[["avg"]]) + 1, # nr of folds
      max(unlist(init_grid_all[["avg"]])) + 1 # size of initial grid
    )
  ) # cores - 1, or max needed by folds & initial grid, depending on whats lower
  cl <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(workers)
  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)

  t <- tune_wf_set(
    models = spec_all[model_id],
    recipes = recipes_all[[data_id]][model_id],
    resamples = cv_all[[data_id]],
    params = params_all[[data_id]][model_id],
    metrics = tune_metrics,
    initial = init_grid_all[[data_id]][model_id],
    iter = 20,
    save_workflow = TRUE,
    save_pred = TRUE
  )

  # disable parallelization
  foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  parallel::stopCluster(cl)
}


t_res <- t %>%
  extract_workflow_set_result(paste0(model_id, "_", model_id))

t_params <- t_res %>%
  select_best()

t_preds <- t %>% collect_predictions(parameters = t_params)

# conf_mat(truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y, estimate = .pred_class, data = t_preds)

print(paste0(
  "ROC-AUC: ",
  t_preds %>%
    roc_auc(truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y, .pred_TRUE),
  ", PR-AUC: ",
  t_preds %>%
    pr_auc(truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y, .pred_TRUE)
))

t_preds %>%
  roc_curve(truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y, .pred_TRUE) %>%
  autoplot() -
  partial(export_return, filename = paste0("05_roc-curve_", data_id, model_id), width = 5, height = 5)

t_preds %>%
  pr_curve(truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y, .pred_TRUE) %>%
  autoplot() -
  partial(export_return, filename = paste0("05_pr-curve_", data_id, model_id), width = 5, height = 5)
```


# Compute & export

```{r}
#| label: set time limit

tune_time_limit <- 6 * 60 # specified in minutes
```

```{r}
#| label: avg

# enable parallelization
workers <- min(
  parallelly::availableCores() - 1,
  max(
    nrow(cv_all[["avg"]]) + 1, # nr of folds
    max(unlist(init_grid_all[["avg"]])) + 1 # size of initial grid
  )
) # cores - 1, or max needed by folds & initial grid, depending on whats lower
cl <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(workers)
doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)

wfset_avg <- tune_wf_set(
  models = spec_all,
  recipes = recipes_all[["avg"]],
  resamples = cv_all[["avg"]],
  params = params_all[["avg"]],
  metrics = tune_metrics,
  initial = init_grid_all[["avg"]],
  time_limit = tune_time_limit
)

# disable parallelization
foreach::registerDoSEQ()
parallel::stopCluster(cl)

save_wf_set(wfset_avg, "avg")
rm(train_avg, wfset_avg)
```
